'''Miesa''' is [[Delana Mosalaine]]'s servant.

==Activities==
She was last seen fleeing [[Salidar]] with Delana and [[Halima]] when [[Jahar Narishma]] detected someone channeling ''[[saidin]]'' in a place where there were only women.

Her status following Delana being revealed as [[Black Ajah]] is unknown. She may have fled her mistress' employ or may have been killed when [[Rand al'Thor]] [[balefire]]d [[Natrin's Barrow]].
